title: Answering With More Than Yes
label: ch:ka-replies
canDo: I can answer in Kannada with more than yes and no --- true, enough, certainly, perhaps, just so --- and see the three-vowel grid running under ಇದು, ಅದು and ಹೇಗೆ.

payoff.summary: Complete KA-C49-just-so and say all five words in order.
